breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly instructs to use the standard formula for a uniformly distributed load on a simply supported beam, rather than replacing the distributed load with its resultant at midspan. It explicitly states 'Calculate the deflection contribution from the distributed load using the standard formula for a uniformly distributed load on a simply supported beam,' which aligns with the ground truth approach and avoids the incorrect resultant substitution present in the incomplete prompt.
